value.text: The real sign-in logic lives in APIV1Service.SignIn, with ConnectServiceHandler.SignIn just wrapping it. I want to check that file for more context.

This confirms `APIV1Service.SignIn` in `server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go` is the actual handler implementing the SignIn RPC's business logic (authenticating via password or SSO credentials, issuing tokens). The `ConnectServiceHandler.SignIn` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` is just a thin Connect-RPC wrapper that calls into it.

q04.
`APIV1Service.SignIn` — `server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go` (function defined at line 51)

This is the core implementation of the SignIn RPC (handling password and SSO credential authentication, issuing the access token and refresh-token cookie). It's invoked through a thin wrapper, `ConnectServiceHandler.SignIn` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` (line 78), which just adapts the Connect-RPC transport and delegates directly to `APIV1Service.SignIn`.
